annotations.title: Prediction market order book at an instant

description: Top-10 order book (bids and asks) of a Polymarket or Kalshi market recorded closest to a given instant (1-minute snapshots, within ±30 min; recorded for the top markets). Get the market id from prediction_search_markets (free). Data is delayed by at least 24 hours (independently recorded from the public Polymarket and Kalshi APIs; not affiliated). Price: $0.005 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

at.description: Instant to look up: ISO-8601 date-time in UTC ('Z') or with an offset (2026-11-20T12:00:00Z, 2026-11-20T13:00:00+01:00), a plain date (2026-11-20 = midnight UTC) or Unix epoch seconds (1795132800). The snapshot closest to it within +/- 30 minutes is returned. Default and maximum: the data cutoff (now minus 24 h).

id.description: Market id: numeric Polymarket id (e.g. 559651) or Kalshi ticker (e.g. KXELONMARS-99); 'polymarket:<id>' / 'kalshi:<ticker>' also accepted

platform.description: Platform: polymarket or kalshi (lower case). Optional, default: inferred from the id (numeric id = polymarket, otherwise kalshi); ignored when the id is prefixed with 'polymarket:' or 'kalshi:'.

name: prediction_market_orderbook
